_comment: TANK ACCUMULATOR sleeve — buy the tanks and ACCUMULATE them; trim only on a REAL move (a profit target or a genuine overbought rip), not the first up-wiggle. Holds a CORE (never sold); strikes with dry powder when a WATCH name has fallen a lot (drawdown ladder + deep RSI(2)); if nothing tanks for backstop_days, feeds the core so cash never rots (melt-ice-cube). Long-only (cash account). REWORK 2026-08-18: the old sell-the-first-bounce (RSI2>70 or >5DMA) churned pennies on a tiny account — replaced with profit_target / RSI2>90 rip / timeout / catastrophe-stop, + a post-exit re-entry cooldown so a stop can't whipsaw straight back in. Sizes off the tank budget in allocation.py. Edit knobs here, git push.

_param_help.unit_dollars: $ per ladder 'unit'. A 4-unit deep tank buys 4x this. Scale with the account.
_param_help.dd_ladder: drawdown from the hi_lookback-day high -> target UNITS. Deeper fall = more units = bigger buy.
_param_help.rsi_tank: RSI(rsi_len) below this adds +1 unit (deep-oversold kicker).
_param_help.profit_target: TRIM the tranche once it's up this much vs AVERAGE cost (e.g. 0.20 = +20%). The main exit — let winners actually run instead of scalping the first bounce.
_param_help.trim_rsi: also TRIM on a genuine overbought RIP (RSI(rsi_len) above this, e.g. 90). Deliberately high so a normal wiggle doesn't trip it.
_param_help.timeout_days: soft guardrail: exit a tranche that hasn't hit target after this many days (dead money).
_param_help.stop_pct: catastrophe stop: exit if a tranche is down more than this vs average cost (e.g. -0.25 = -25%).
_param_help.reentry_cooldown_days: after ANY exit on a name, don't re-buy it for this many days (anti-whipsaw so a stop can't flip straight back in).
_param_help.max_names: max simultaneous opportunistic tank positions (concentration cap).
_param_help.cooldown_days: min days between adds/trims on one name.
_param_help.backstop_days: if NO tank buy fires for this many days, deploy backstop_dollars into core[0] (melt-ice-cube).
_param_help.backstop_dollars: $ deployed into the core when the backstop fires.
